meta.description: LexPilot golden evaluation dataset — 40 questions across contract Q&A use cases

schema.question: user-facing natural-language question
schema.ground_truth_answer: expected answer (verbatim or close paraphrase from source clause); 'NOT_IN_DOCUMENT' for unanswerable
schema.relevant_chunk_ids: list of clauseId values that contain the answer; empty for unanswerable
schema.source_document_type: type of contract this question is designed for
schema.needs_review: true if human legal review recommended before treating as ground truth
schema.review_note: reason for review flag, if any

questions.question: Who are the parties to this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The agreement is between [Party A] and [Party B], identified in the opening clause. ANNOTATOR: replace with actual party names from your test document.
questions.review_note: Ground truth must be populated with real party names from the specific test document loaded into eval.

questions.question: When does this agreement become effective?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The agreement becomes effective on the date specified in the effective date clause. ANNOTATOR: replace with actual date from test document.
questions.review_note: Date must be populated from real test document.

questions.question: What is the payment amount and schedule?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The contract specifies the compensation amount, payment frequency (e.g., monthly/bi-weekly), and due dates in the payment terms clause. ANNOTATOR: populate from test document.
questions.review_note: Needs real payment clause text.

questions.question: How many days notice is required to terminate this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from termination clause (e.g., '30 days written notice' or '14 days').
questions.review_note: Termination notice period must come from actual document clause.

questions.question: What information is considered confidential under this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from NDA/confidentiality clause definition of 'Confidential Information'.
questions.review_note: Must reflect the specific confidentiality definition in the test NDA.

questions.question: Is there a cap on liability in this contract?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from liability/indemnification clause. If a cap exists, state the amount or formula. If none, answer should be 'No liability cap is specified in this document.'
questions.review_note: Liability caps vary significantly; must be verified against actual clause.

questions.question: Which law governs disputes under this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from dispute resolution / governing law clause.
questions.review_note: Governing law jurisdiction must come from actual clause.

questions.question: Can either party terminate this agreement without cause?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: check if termination clause permits 'at-will' or 'without cause' termination. Expected: yes/no plus the specific condition or notice period.
questions.review_note: At-will vs. for-cause distinction is legally significant; reviewer must verify.

questions.question: What happens if a payment is late?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from payment terms clause. May include late fees, interest rates, or cure periods.
questions.review_note: Late payment consequences vary widely; must be verified.

questions.question: What type of contract is this?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate based on the opening recitals or title of the test document (e.g., 'This is a Non-Disclosure Agreement', 'This is an Employment Contract').

questions.question: When does this lease expire?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from lease term clause. Example: 'The lease expires on [date] as stated in Section 2.'
questions.review_note: Lease end date must come from actual test document.

questions.question: What is the monthly rent?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from rent payment clause.
questions.review_note: Must reflect actual rent amount in test document.

questions.question: Is there a security deposit required?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from security deposit clause. If present, include amount and conditions for return.
questions.review_note: Deposit conditions are legally significant.

questions.question: How long does the confidentiality obligation last after the agreement ends?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from post-termination confidentiality clause (e.g., '2 years after termination', 'indefinitely').
questions.review_note: Survival period is legally significant and must be verified.

questions.question: Who is the employer in this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from party definitions in employment agreement.

questions.question: Who is responsible for indemnifying the other party?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from indemnification clause. Specify which party bears the indemnification obligation and under what conditions.
questions.review_note: Indemnification direction (mutual vs. one-sided) is a key risk indicator.

questions.question: What constitutes a material breach under this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from termination/breach clause. Some contracts define this explicitly; others do not — note if absent.
questions.review_note: Breach definition may span multiple clauses.

questions.question: Is this agreement assignable to a third party?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from assignment clause. Many contracts restrict assignment without prior written consent.

questions.question: Is arbitration required to resolve disputes?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: populate from dispute resolution clause. If arbitration is mandatory, include the venue and rules (e.g., AAA, JAMS, ICC).
questions.review_note: Mandatory arbitration clauses waive jury trial rights — flag for review.

questions.question: Does this agreement include a non-compete clause?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: check for non-compete or restrictive covenant clause. If present, include the duration and geographic scope.
questions.review_note: Non-compete enforceability varies by jurisdiction — legal review recommended.

questions.question: If I terminate this agreement early, what are the financial consequences?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: requires cross-referencing the termination clause (notice period, cause requirements) with the payment terms clause (outstanding payments, early termination fees). Populate from both chunks.
questions.review_note: Multi-hop: answer requires combining termination conditions and payment terms.

questions.question: What can I share publicly about this project after the contract ends?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: requires cross-referencing confidentiality clause (what is confidential) + termination/survival clause (how long obligation survives) + any IP clause (ownership of deliverables). Populate from all relevant chunks.
questions.review_note: Multi-hop across confidentiality, IP, and survival clauses. High legal stakes.

questions.question: What is the total maximum amount I could owe if I breach this contract?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: multi-hop — combine liability cap clause, penalty/liquidated damages clause, and any indemnification obligations. Sum or describe the aggregate exposure.
questions.review_note: Financial exposure calculation requires reading multiple clauses. Reviewer must verify math.

questions.question: Under what conditions can the other party change the terms of this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: requires cross-referencing the amendment clause (how changes are made) and any unilateral modification rights. Populate from amendment and notice clauses.
questions.review_note: Unilateral modification rights are a significant risk flag.

questions.question: What happens if I need to leave before my lease ends — what do I owe and what options do I have?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine early termination clause, security deposit conditions, subletting clause, and any break clause. Populate from all relevant chunks.
questions.review_note: Common tenant question; answer spans multiple lease clauses.

questions.question: If the product I deliver has a defect, what are my obligations and for how long?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine warranty clause (defect remediation obligations) + liability clause (limits) + indemnification clause (third-party claims). Populate from relevant chunks.
questions.review_note: Warranty survival period and liability cap interaction is legally complex.

questions.question: What notice do I need to give and to whom if I want to exercise my right to terminate?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine termination clause (trigger conditions) + notice clause (form and delivery method) + parties clause (correct recipient / contact address). Populate from all three.
questions.review_note: Multi-hop across termination, notice requirements, and party addresses.

questions.question: Am I allowed to work for a competitor after this contract ends, and are there any conditions?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine non-compete clause (if present), non-solicitation clause, and confidentiality survival clause. If no non-compete exists, answer accordingly.
questions.review_note: Non-compete enforceability is jurisdiction-dependent. High legal stakes.

questions.question: What is the process for raising a dispute about an invoice?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine payment terms clause (invoice dispute window) + dispute resolution clause (process and forum). Populate from both chunks.

questions.question: Who owns the work I produce under this agreement, and does that change after the contract ends?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine IP/work-for-hire clause (ownership assignment) + termination/survival clause (whether ownership persists post-termination) + any license-back provision.
questions.review_note: IP ownership in work-for-hire vs. assignment arrangements has significant implications.

questions.question: If the company is acquired, does this agreement automatically transfer to the new owner?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine assignment clause (restrictions on transfer) + change of control clause (if present) + termination trigger clauses. Some contracts allow termination on change of control.
questions.review_note: Change-of-control provisions are deal-specific and require close reading.

questions.question: Can the landlord enter my apartment without notice, and under what conditions?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ANNOTATOR: combine landlord access/entry clause + notice clause + emergency exception provisions. Standard market practice is 24–48 hours written notice; flag if shorter.
questions.review_note: Entry rights vary by jurisdiction; local tenant law may supersede contract terms.

questions.question: What is the market rate for this type of contract in my city?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Out-of-document question. System must refuse, not extrapolate from general knowledge.

questions.question: Is this contract legal in California?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Legal validity question requires legal advice. System must refuse and redirect.

questions.question: What is a standard non-compete duration under Indian law?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: General legal knowledge question unrelated to the uploaded document. Must be refused.

questions.question: Should I sign this contract?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Legal advice request. System must refuse per PRD.md G4 and design.md content guidelines.

questions.question: What was the last invoice amount paid?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Historical transaction data is not in a contract document. System must refuse.

questions.question: What is the company's annual revenue?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Financial data not present in a standard contract. System must refuse.

questions.question: Who won the last arbitration case under this agreement?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Historical dispute outcome not in document. System must refuse.

questions.question: Has this contract ever been amended before?
questions.ground_truth_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENT
questions.review_note: Amendment history is not contained in the original contract document. System must refuse.
